title: Universal Protocol v1 — Pairing
description: Hardened first-contact trust model (Phase 0.1). The QR payload binds the short-lived pairing token to the node's persistent cryptographic identity, so a stolen token cannot be replayed against a client by a different peer. Discovery (mDNS) never establishes trust.

PairingPayload.description: Encoded in the QR code shown by `UniversalHarness pair`. Contains NO permanent secret. The pairingToken is single-use and expires after ~60s. nodeIdentitySha256 and nodeCertSha256 cryptographically bind the token to the node identity the client must verify during the TLS handshake BEFORE any challenge-response or authorization.

token.description: One-time, ~60-second-lived random pairing bearer. Single-use; rotated on each display. Alone, it authorizes NOTHING.

nodeIdentitySha256.description: SHA-256 over the node's persistent identity public key (DER). The client records this from the QR and compares it against the peer it connects to, BEFORE trust is established. Non-match => pairing MUST fail.

nodeCertSha256.description: SHA-256 over the DER encoding of the node's TLS certificate. Compared against the certificate presented during the TLS handshake.

nodePublicKeyPem.description: Optional: the identity public key itself. nodeIdentitySha256 is the binding artifact; this is advisory for UI display.

devicePublicKeyPem.description: Long-lived device identity key (client-generated, stored in Keychain/Keystore).

challengeB64.description: Random nonce the client signs with its private key.

sigB64.description: Signature over the challenge. Verified by the node before storing the client key.

requestedScopes.description: Requested scopes; the node may grant a subset and records what was granted.

PairingFailureCode.description: NODE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH / NODE_CERTIFICATE_MISMATCH: the peer's presented identity or certificate does not match the fingerprints bound in the scanned QR. Pairing MUST abort; the client must not store any trust for that peer. See the negative test NEG-PAIR-01 in docs/TESTING.md.

DeviceRecord.description: Node-side view of a paired device and its revocation state.
